text: The design author reports executing no tests for this design commit.
strongestWording: No tests were executed for this design commit.
scope: Design commit only; not an assertion that the repositories have no tests. Author activity would require execution records to verify.

text: Treat original deep-audit candidate references as hypotheses until a red test exercises them.
strongestWording: original deep-audit candidate references are hypotheses until a red test exercises them.
scope: Evidence classification policy for the source audit; not a finding that each candidate is defective.

text: Function admission computes the input digest after withoutBeadsNotes strips note text.
strongestWording: Function admission digests withoutBeadsNotes(input)
scope: Pi function admission calculation, not dispatched function execution.

text: The script-style launcher structure reads the original params.input.
strongestWording: the script-style launcher structure reads original params.input.
scope: Pi current launcher input construction; does not assert a function is launched through it.

text: A new function route must dispatch precisely the canonical input admitted.
strongestWording: A new function route MUST dispatch exactly the admitted canonical input.
scope: Target Pi function route; requirement force is distinct from the source mismatch premise.

text: No current function launch occurs in the registered Pi route.
strongestWording: No current function launch occurs.
scope: Pi registered workflow_execute path. Detection surface: execute-tool.ts kind dispatch plus src/index.ts launcher wiring; not all hypothetical callers of internal helpers.

text: WriterLeases uses in-memory lease ownership.
strongestWording: An in-memory lease
scope: Pi source admission WriterLeases storage; no claim about separate future lease implementations.

text: The source-admission lease is released when the dispatch promise resolves.
strongestWording: An in-memory lease is released when the dispatch promise resolves.
scope: Pi admitSourceWrite dispatch lifetime; independent of whether a native writer has terminated.

text: A detached or asynchronous launch may return while its writer is still running.
strongestWording: A detached or asynchronous launch may return before the writer terminates
scope: Conditional launcher-lifetime hazard, not an observed joined Mechanical failure. Test surface: a dispatch promise resolving with a paused native writer.

text: Move writer ownership to persistent invocation lifetime.
strongestWording: move ownership to persistent invocation lifetime.
scope: Target Pi P02/P03 ownership model.

text: The registered Pi execute tool supports script execution only.
strongestWording: Registered tool supports script only
scope: Pi registered tool execution, not model schema vocabulary. Detection surface: execute-tool.ts non-script branch and index.ts launcher wiring.

text: The registered execution path does not transitively compose function authority, descriptor/source guards and the Mechanical host.
strongestWording: function authority, descriptor/source guards and Mechanical host are not transitively wired.
scope: One conjunction claim about a composed route; does not assert the individual components are absent. Detection surface: registered execute-tool.ts route and src/index.ts dependency wiring.

text: Independent source and authority rechecks do not by themselves form an atomic policy across asynchronous waits.
strongestWording: Independent rechecks are individually valuable but do not form one atomic policy across async waits
scope: Pi source-admission.ts and function-authority.ts composition; a reasoning claim, not a demonstrated race or assertion of a currently exploitable function route.

text: Revalidate all mutable policy facts at the final effect boundary.
strongestWording: revalidate all mutable facts at final effect boundary.
scope: Target Pi composed dispatch policy.

text: The production-exported FUNCTION_ACTION_CONTRACT is unadopted and blocked on MW-CONTRACT.
strongestWording: Adopted function grant is absent from production export (FUNCTION_ACTION_CONTRACT = unadopted / MW-CONTRACT).
scope: Pi exported default only; does not deny helper support for adopted contracts. Detection surface: FUNCTION_ACTION_CONTRACT value and refusal handling in function-authority.ts.

text: The candidate mechanical:develop-write grant requires explicit joint acceptance.
strongestWording: Candidate mechanical:develop-write requires joint explicit acceptance.
scope: Pi/MW proposed action spelling; not a statement of adoption or a current supported grant.

text: Pi provides bounded, scoped native observation.
strongestWording: Bounded scoped native observation exists
scope: Existing Pi observation implementation and tool handlers, not joined Mechanical observation.

text: Mechanical logical invocation is not connected end-to-end to producer references, evidence and separate effect disposition.
strongestWording: Mechanical logical invocation -> producer refs, evidence and separate effect disposition are not connected.
scope: Joined Pi Mechanical observation projection. Detection surface: observation.ts plus registered execution/observation tool handlers; not provider-native standalone evidence.

text: Detached script integrity and preserve-on-failure safeguards already exist.
strongestWording: Existing detached script integrity and preserve-on-failure safeguards
scope: Pi script-host safety baseline, independent of Mechanical function support; preservation premise also appears in section C. The document cites the bare name worktree.ts: at the pin only src/worktree.ts exists (no src/workbench/worktree.ts), so the citation resolution itself needs checking.

text: Preserve existing detached script safeguards and keep Mechanical function execution distinct from script execution.
strongestWording: Existing detached script integrity and preserve-on-failure safeguards must remain; Mechanical function must not masquerade as script execution.
scope: Compatibility boundary for Pi P08/P09.

text: W11 remains historically not shipped.
strongestWording: W11 historical state remains not-shipped
scope: Pi feature-matrix/agent-playbook shipment state at the inspected pin. Detection surface: W11 rows and corresponding skill claims, not every unrelated shipped primitive.

text: Agent playbooks must not infer shipment from this design program.
strongestWording: agent playbooks must not infer shipment from this program.
scope: Program authorship versus release status.

text: I1 binds execution identity to exact reviewed definition, schema, descriptor, tarball, runtime manifest and validated input bytes; post-admission mutation must refuse or stay uncertain, and a filename is not authority.
strongestWording: The exact reviewed definition ID, schema, descriptor digest, tarball digest, runtime file manifest digest and validated input bytes identify execution. Any post-admission mutation refuses or remains uncertain; filenames alone authorize nothing.
scope: Target immutable execution identity rule; does not claim all these checks exist at the pins.

text: I2 requires authority, scope, source basis, profiles and effect budget to originate in trusted host state rather than model/tool metadata.
strongestWording: Principal, session, permissions, authorized roots, lease token, source basis, chosen evidence/context profiles and effect budget come from trusted host state, not tool JSON, Beads notes or annotations.
scope: Target host-only authority rule; no assertion that profile names already have code witnesses.

text: I3 requires digest/dispatch/replay identity over the same typed canonical input, excludes stripped Beads notes, rejects nonrepresentable or over-budget forms, and forbids silent policy widening.
strongestWording: Function inputDigest is computed over the same typed canonical JSON that reaches Mechanical; stripped Beads note text is neither hashed nor dispatched nor used for replay/admission. Reject unrepresentable, accessor/cyclic/budget-exceeding forms. Never silently widen a caller policy.
scope: Target canonical input rule, not a claim about an existing joined function dispatch.

text: I4 requires re-reading mutable authority and source facts and asserting ownership before effects, plus validating immutable artifacts against the runtime manifest.
strongestWording: Before effect dispatch, re-read effective principal/session/grants, re-measure authorized root/Git HEAD/tree/status/Forge manifest and assert resource/lease ownership. Validate already-verified immutable artifacts against the runtime manifest.
scope: Target final-boundary rule; prior verification is a precondition, not an assertion that runtime manifests are presently implemented.

text: I5 retains ownership until safe native settlement, fences uncertain or recovering invocations, and requires another host/process to observe the same authoritative lease.
strongestWording: A lease cannot be released on "launched". Ownership lasts until a native terminal with safe settlement, or remains fenced in uncertain/recovering state. A second host/process sees the same authoritative lease.
scope: Target exclusive ownership rule, not current distributed-lease behavior.

text: I6 distinguishes launch acceptance from completion, requires validated native evidence for Mechanical verified_candidate, and prevents observed status from granting control.
strongestWording: accepted/launched != completed; Mechanical verified_candidate is a domain claim requiring validated native evidence, not merely an SDK response or Forge transport success; observed status does not grant control.
scope: Target semantics of independently meaningful status/evidence/authority statements; not a claim that legacy results already satisfy the strict verifier.

text: I7 maps ambiguous post-effect outcomes or missing evidence to explicit uncertainty, retained native references and no blind replay.
strongestWording: Lost acknowledgment, cancellation after effects, killed worker, stale source or missing native evidence produce explicit uncertainty, retained native refs and zero blind replay.
scope: Target failure/uncertainty policy; the enumerated scenarios are required inputs, not reports of observed incidents.

text: I8 restricts first release to reviewed mechanical.development.develop.v1 and exact mechanical:develop-write, forbidding arbitrary export imports and full ambient host permissions.
strongestWording: First release permits only reviewed mechanical.development.develop.v1 with exact mechanical:develop-write; do not dynamically import arbitrary package exports or pass the host's full ambient permissions.
scope: Proposed least-privilege release allowlist; exact grant adoption remains conditional.

text: I9 assigns provider semantics/IDs/evidence to Mechanical, runtime/scope/scheduling/observation/control to Pi, and only explicit optional durable Run/Attempt ownership to Furnace.
strongestWording: Mechanical owns develop() semantics and provider-native ids/evidence. Pi owns runtime, scope, scheduling, observation projection and control. Furnace optionally owns separate durable Run/Attempt, never implicitly.
scope: Target responsibility allocation across products; not a claim that the integration or Furnace delegation already exists.

text: I10 keeps direct L2, older native L3 and Pi script evidence separate; only registered Pi invocation proves V3/V4, and receipts/gate passes must not be invented.
strongestWording: Existing direct Mechanical L2, older native L3 and Pi script tests remain separate; only an actual registered Pi invocation proves V3/V4. No invented receipts or gate passes.
scope: Evidence sufficiency rule; embedded existence premises split into C068-C070.

text: Direct Mechanical L2 evidence already exists.
strongestWording: Existing direct Mechanical L2
scope: Mechanical direct installed-host L2 evidence at paired snapshot; no assertion of registered Pi coverage.

text: Older Mechanical native L3 evidence exists.
strongestWording: older native L3
scope: Historical native Mechanical evidence preceding MII; exact producer receipt and revision are not cited here and must be acquired in later evidence tracing.

text: Pi script tests exist.
strongestWording: Pi script tests
scope: Pi script test corpus at the inspected pin; existence is not execution, pass status or Mechanical integration coverage.

text: Pi already has a model-facing tool-reply/v1 envelope to preserve.
strongestWording: Maintain the Pi model-facing tool-reply/v1 envelope
scope: Embedded compatibility premise concerning Pi tool replies; existence only, not universal compliance.

text: Pi already exposes explicit completion-not-asserted launch semantics to preserve.
strongestWording: the explicit "completion:not-asserted" launch semantics.
scope: Embedded Pi launch compatibility premise. Validate semantic representation rather than assuming the quoted spelling must occur literally.

text: Mechanical already exports the @mechanical/development-rig/host package subpath.
strongestWording: @mechanical/development-rig/host already exists.
scope: Paired MW snapshot package export; existence is not proof of Pi execution or complete packed artifact closure.

text: An earlier schema-filename defect has been fixed.
strongestWording: the earlier schema-filename fix
scope: Historical correction presupposed by section C; no commit, file or prior finding ID is supplied on this line. Later verification must identify the fix rather than invent its identity.

text: An earlier source-worktree-preservation defect has been fixed.
strongestWording: source worktree preservation fix
scope: Historical correction presupposed by section C; do not infer that every preservation scenario is covered. Exact fix provenance remains to be traced.

text: Do not reopen the earlier schema-filename or worktree-preservation fixes absent fresh failing evidence.
strongestWording: Do NOT reopen the earlier schema-filename fix or source worktree preservation fix without fresh failing evidence.
scope: Regression evidence policy for prior MNI findings.

text: The pi-consumer name refers to an independently installed Node consumer, not an actual registered Pi execution.
strongestWording: an independently installed Node consumer named pi-consumer
scope: MW fixture named pi-consumer at the paired snapshot; inspect its launcher and imports to distinguish its identity from Pi, rather than treating the label as proof.

text: Do not present an independently installed Node consumer named pi-consumer as actual Pi tool execution.
strongestWording: Do NOT conflate an independently installed Node consumer named pi-consumer with actual Pi tool execution.
scope: Claim boundary for independent-consumer evidence.

text: Exclude a generic function registry, SDK-filter sandbox claims, mandatory HX semantic completeness/RF committed rendering, mandatory Forge-Furnace coupling, and GitHub CI from this program.
strongestWording: No generic function registry, no sandbox claim from SDK prompt/tool filters, no required HX semantic completeness or RF committed rendering, no Forge↔Furnace requirement, no GitHub CI.
scope: Design non-goals; not empirical claims that these features do or do not exist.

text: A naive launcher could pass note-bearing original input unchanged after admitting only the stripped task input.
strongestWording: input { task:"X", notes:"untrusted" } admitted as { task:"X" } yet passed through unchanged to a naive launcher.
scope: Canonical-note counterexample shape for a future function route; not a current joined invocation. Detection surface proposed by the document: exact canonical bytes at Mechanical callback.

text: A native-handle-returning launch could release ownership while its writer is paused before the first edit.
strongestWording: launch returns native handle while worker is paused at first edit
scope: Early-release adversarial test shape; proposed falsifier is whether a second invocation remains blocked, not a claimed existing occurrence.

text: Authority and source checks could become stale if source changes before artifact import or a grant is revoked after installation but before first effect.
strongestWording: principal unchanged when function authority checks; source changes before artifact import; grant revoked after installation but before first writer effect.
scope: Split-guard temporal counterexample shape; independent mutations are test inputs, not observed exploits. Proposed required outcome: refuse before effects.

text: A producer may already have performed effects when its acknowledgment is lost.
strongestWording: producer might have edited, committed or dispatched Forge but acknowledgment is dropped
scope: Post-dispatch loss possibility for the target joined route; no actual occurrence asserted. Required journal/fence/no-default-retry response is captured by I5/I7.

text: Mechanical may report a legacy PASS frame without native gate/tree/environment bindings.
strongestWording: Mechanical may report a legacy PASS frame lacking native gate/tree/environment bindings
scope: Paired Mechanical producer result shape is the empirical premise to test; possible legacy output is not strict verified evidence. Preserve weak observations without promotion.

text: Define v1 using source hashes and validated bytes, require versioned schema validators and unknown-version refusal, preserve existing script/scope/envelope/launch semantics, and expose actual later producer results via workflow_observe.
strongestWording: Define v1 around source hashes and validated artifact bytes; changing a schema requires a versioned validator and explicit refusal for unknown versions. Do not upgrade existing script envelopes or observer scopes silently. Maintain the Pi model-facing tool-reply/v1 envelope and the explicit "completion:not-asserted" launch semantics. Expose the producer's actual domain result later through workflow_observe.
scope: Target v1 compatibility boundary; existing envelope and launch premises separated into C071-C072.
